name: FormControl
description: `FormControl` is a composable field wrapper that provides label, caption, validation, and control association.

props.name: caption
props.description: Supplies the caption region. Takes precedence over a matching `FormControl.Caption` child.

props.name: label
props.description: Supplies the label region. Takes precedence over a matching `FormControl.Label` child.

props.name: layout
props.description: Whether the label sits above the control or beside it, as it does for a checkbox or radio.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Supplies the leadingVisual region. Takes precedence over a matching `FormControl.LeadingVisual` child.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required, which is reflected on the control and shown on the label.

props.name: validation
props.description: Supplies the validation region. Takes precedence over a matching `FormControl.Validation` child.

props.name: requiredIndicator
props.description: Shows the required marker. Set `false` to keep the field required without marking it.

props.name: requiredText
props.description: Text used for the required marker in place of the default.

props.name: visuallyHidden
props.description: Hides the label visually while keeping it available to assistive technology.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the message reports a problem or confirms success.
